name: accessibility-scanner
title: Accessibility Scanner
description: WCAG-oriented accessibility signals for every page: images missing alt text, heading hierarchy violations, missing page titles and language declarations - prioritized issue lists per crawl.

input.title: Input schema for Pry Accessibility Scanner
input.description: WCAG-oriented accessibility signals for every page: images missing alt text, heading hierarchy violations, missing page titles and language declarations - prioritized issue lists per crawl.

urls.title: Target URLs
urls.description: One or more https:// URLs to process.

max_pages.title: Max pages
max_pages.description: Hard cap on processed pages (runaway protection).

fail_on_missing_alt.title: Flag missing alt text
fail_on_missing_alt.description: Report every image without an alt attribute.

max_items.title: Max items (cost cap)
max_items.description: Hard cap on processed items for this run - keeps trial costs predictable. Billing stops when the cap or your spending limit is reached.

proxy_configuration.title: Proxy configuration
proxy_configuration.description: Apify proxy settings passed through to Pry's premium-proxy tier. Leave default to use the platform proxy automatically.
